policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For B in a single-pickup goal, read the requested color from the goal, locate its cube in the pre-covering frames of the current observation, and follow the covering event to its resting container. For B in a multiple-pickup goal, select the resting container covering the first stored position, using the covering event when visible or the nearest resting container to that position otherwise.
